purpose: Paired short-prefill comparison between Infernal Invocation r6 and r7

conditions.gpu: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Workstation Edition, 97887 MiB
conditions.method: Each prompt was submitted to both servers, submission order alternated by sample, every sample used a unique first prefix block, and one full-shape warmup per server was excluded.

result.conclusion: The paired measurement shows short-prefill parity. The r7 composition does not reproduce the previously suspected short-prefill regression.
